# CLI: GlobalLoadBalancer

## create-load-balancer

Kind: Write.

Requires --yes. Automated payment holds credits for a prepaid three-day forecast; a recorded GNLB_4000 create held 176,000 VND (billing get-balances CashHolding), and deleting the load balancer did not release the hold within minutes; later connection and traffic charges apply. Delete does not promise a refund. On NotSettled inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--name` | `string` | yes |
| `--package-id` | `string` | yes |
| `--description` | `string` |  |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer create-load-balancer --name <name> --package-id <package-id> --yes
```

## delete-load-balancer

Kind: Write, destructive.

Requires --yes. Deletion is not a refund promise; later connection and traffic charges may apply. On NotSettled inspect inventory and billing before another mutation.

| Flag | Type | Required |
|-|-|-|
| `--load-balancer-id` | `string` | yes |

```sh
vngcloud globalloadbalancer delete-load-balancer --load-balancer-id <load-balancer-id> --yes
```
